pageDescription: Overwrites the files and folders you add twice (random data, then zeros), then deletes them. They skip the Recycle Bin and cannot be recovered.
emptyDescription: Add files or folders: you will see the list and the total size before anything is destroyed.

checks.protectedDetail: Drive roots, system folders and the main profile folders are refused.
checks.changedDetail: A file replaced or modified during shredding is skipped, not deleted.
checks.linksDetail: Symbolic links are skipped: only what you chose is destroyed.

summaryItems_one: {{items}} item in the list; a folder includes everything inside it
summaryItems_other: {{items}} items in the list; folders include everything inside them
confirmBody: Every file, including those inside folders, is overwritten twice and then deleted. It skips the Recycle Bin and cannot be recovered. On SSDs and on drives with snapshots or backups, copies the overwrite cannot reach may remain.
cancelNote: If you stop, files already shredded stay deleted; the file in progress stays on disk, partly overwritten.
receiptCurrentKept: the file in progress was not deleted
receiptFailed_one: {{failed}} file not shredded: the reason is below.
receiptFailed_other: {{failed}} files not shredded: the reasons are below.

reason.cancelled: Stopped before the overwrite finished: the file was not deleted
reason.unverified: File not verified while collecting: skipped
